content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas and electric utility with propane; no grocery, pharmacy or retail store operations."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Propane distributor and appliance servicer; does not sell groceries, pharmacy goods or operate supermarkets."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"B2B online marketplace for large-item furniture and home goods; not a consumer grocery or pharmacy business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Hot dog brand owner and franchisor of quick-service restaurants; no supermarkets, pharmacy or fuel centers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner and wholesale fuel supplier; shares motor fuel sales but not supermarkets or pharmacy."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Televised and online shopping network selling apparel and jewelry; no physical food stores or pharmacy."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resort operator with gaming and hotels; unrelated to grocery retail."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Propane and heating oil distributor delivering fuel to homes; no grocery, pharmacy or store leasing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Northwest Florida land developer, hotels and resorts; leases property but lacks grocery retail operations."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Uniform rental and laundering for businesses on route service; sells to businesses, not households."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Rent-to-own and lease-to-own retailer of household goods; lacks groceries, pharmacy and fuel."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings and kitchenware retailer with private-label goods; no groceries, pharmacy or fuel."}]}
